templates.name: AI Recipe: Daily App Idea Card
templates.description: Claude researches a current trend and writes a one-page app pitch (problem, user, MVP, monetization, risks, sources) with a concept-art cover. Rotates across five categories so the backlog stays balanced.

templates.name: AI Recipes: Update Clone
templates.description: Fast-forward your ai-automation-recipes clone daily so every scheduled recipe runs the latest prompts and skills. Pairs with any AI Recipe template.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly Browser Game
templates.description: Claude designs and builds a complete single-file HTML game in a rotating genre — playable from file://, touch-aware, syntax-checked before it is published — with a design brief and key-art cover.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Weekly Short Story
templates.description: Claude writes a complete 2,000–4,000-word short story in a rotating genre, avoiding every premise already written, with a portrait cover illustration. Optional idea queue via story-ideas.md.

packs.name: AI Content Recipes
packs.description: Scheduled Claude Code automations that research, write, build and illustrate — app idea cards, playable browser games, short stories — into a folder you can browse.
